preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call withdrawStuckETH() or setOperationsAddress()
Contract must have ETH balance > 0 (from accumulated fees or stuck ETH)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawStuckETH() to transfer all ETH from the contract to your address without checking the return value of the low-level call. Alternatively, set operationsAddress to your address and trigger swapBack() to accumulate ETH in operationsAddress, then call withdrawStuckETH(). The unchecked transfer at lines 478 and 484 (in swapBack() and withdrawStuckETH()) means failed transfers won't revert, but if successful, you'll receive the ETH.
